title: Private Guest House | Parking | Entertainment
description:
-2 free driveway parking spots and additional free street parking
-Minutes to Broadway, Germantown, 12 South, Nissan Stadium, Bridgestone Arena & Vanderbilt
-12 minutes to the airport
-Walking distance to East Nashville restaurants, coffee shops & bars
-High-speed internet
-King bed & queen bed
-Smart TVs in all bedrooms & living room
-Washer & dryer
-Fully stocked kitchen
-Private keyless entry with private exterior courtyard
-Easy access perfect for couples, families, friends & work trips!

The space
We designed this guest house to optimize the Airbnb experience for all travelers! The space has high-speed internet, smart TVs in each bedroom & the living room, a fully stocked kitchen for cooking, free on and off street parking, white noise machines and fresh linens/towels.

We also provide essentials like soaps, toothbrushes and more for your stay. This space is great for couples, adventurers, work, family and friends. Located in the Cleveland Park neighborhood of East Nashville, it’s incredibly convenient to Broadway, Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium, Vanderbilt, all concert venues, museums, food, entertainment and more.

Our guest house is also walking distance to some of East Nashville's best restaurants including Redheaded Stranger, Folk, Xiao Bao, Momento Specialty Coffee, East Nashville Cream & Bean, CHERRIES, Turkey and the Wolf Icehouse & more!

Guest access
Guests will have full access and use of the place 24 hours a day. You can come and go as you like and there’s an electronic lock, so there are no keys to keep up with! I live nearby and can help with anything you might need.

Other things to note
NON-SMOKING UNIT: Under no circumstances are you to smoke inside the Airbnb. We have a private courtyard outside with an ashtray.

NO PARTY POLICY

Please respect the house rules.

Guests are responsible for any damaged items during their stay.

This guest house is a separate building and has a private entrance. The entrance was built to face the alley direction to maximize privacy. See the detailed picture in the message thread before arrival.
